influences.name: PJ Harvey
influences.context: PJ Harvey was a huge inspiration for me and in college, like, she was just such a badass and she went out there into the field of rock when she was so young. And just like in the end, her attitude in interviews was very much like, I just went out there and did whatever the fuck I wanted.

influences.name: Patti Smith
influences.context: I'm thinking of Patti Smith, okay. She's somebody who wonderfully has not tried to tailor her looks to the male gaze in the last 20 years, you know, but she is so beloved and she's so sought after and seen as this wise, artful person

influences.name: Faure
influences.context: For this piece, the main influences were (in no particular order) Bach, Mozart, Faure, Joni Mitchell, Palestrina, Hildegard von Bingen, Byrd, Arvo Pärt, Simon & Garfunkel, Sufjan Stevens, and too much other folk and pop music to name…
